purpose: Teach: 打ち切り/有価/作り上げる/使い捨て/版元/レスポンス/率先/囲む

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、不採算事業の打ち切りを断行された
lines.en: When you founded the company, you made the hard decision to cut unprofitable operations.
lines.style: Measured, reflective opening. Soft pause after the first phrase—allowing gravity to settle. Speaking as someone recalling a pivotal moment with respect. Steady, unhurried delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは有価証券を活用された
lines.en: Yes. You used financial instruments strategically to sustain the vision.
lines.style: Calm affirmation with quiet conviction. Not boastful—factual, grounded. A son acknowledging his father's foresight. Slightly lower register, almost tender in its steadiness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、ブランドを社員と作り上げる事を信条にされた
lines.en: You believed that a brand should be built together with the people who work for you.
lines.style: Gentle, thoughtful tone. Speaking of a principle held with quiet certainty. Slight breathiness—this mattered deeply. Slow enough to let the words land.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは使い捨て文化を批判された
lines.en: Yes. You stood against disposable culture when most didn't.
lines.style: Soft acknowledgment with underlying strength. A light emphasis on the contrast—'when most didn't.' Respectful but not effusive. The quiet pride of a son who inherited both the belief and the burden.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、書籍版元との関係を大切にされた
lines.en: You valued your relationships with publishers as sacred partnerships.
lines.style: Wistful but grounded. Speaking of something that has lasted. Slight trailing-off at the end—these partnerships outlived the moment. Warmth without sentimentality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは顧客レスポンスを最重視された
lines.en: Yes. You made customer responsiveness non-negotiable in everything you did.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. A touch of emphasis on 'everything'—this was foundational, not optional. Steady delivery. The voice of someone who watched this principle in action.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員が率先する組織を理想とされた
lines.en: Your ideal was an organization where people led, not followed orders.
lines.style: Contemplative, almost philosophical. Slight pause at the beginning—gathering the weight of this ideal. Slow pace. The voice of someone still learning what this vision means.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員を信頼で囲む経営をされた
lines.en: Yes. You built a company by surrounding your people with trust, not suspicion.
lines.style: Closing statement—firm, complete. A light emphasis on 'trust'—this was the cornerstone. Warm but dignified. The final piece of a portrait being drawn with reverence. Breath settles at the end.
